doc.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13

chapter: Dave Bailey: brass bands and playing career
title: Working with the Gibson band after Jimmy Jackson's death
summary: Bailey explains he has been with the band since Jimmy Jackson died and others took it over; Jackson only managed it.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Okay. And you've been working with a Gibson band, I guess, for the last... How long have you been with a Gibson band?

Well, I've been working with... I don't know how long it's been, but I know after this fella died... Yeah. ...Alphonse Fish, who was playing in the band... Yeah. ...and he took the band over after he died. Oh, no. Jimmy Jackson. Oh, yeah. He's living on the south, you know.
He didn't play any instrument, did he, Jackson? He just managed the band. He used to play, but he stopped him. Yeah, yeah, just managed the band. Yeah.
He died. How long have you been dead? Uh-huh.
So you've been with him a long while then? Hmm? You've been with Gibson a long while? Yeah.
Pretty good. I don't know what dad was, he died.
Yeah. Okay, well, I guess that...
When I was working at the hospital... Yeah. ...his daughter came in, I believe he was dead. Last time she came in, I believe she said he was dead five years. Yeah.
